tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Local Embedding Theorem] ↗ \cite{LeeSM} \dcref{chA:A.16} Every smooth immersion is locally an embedding: if $F: M \to N$ is a smooth immersion, then for every $p \in M$, there is a neighborhood $U$ of $p$ in $M$ such that $F|_U$ is an embedding.
